'''Yoba''' is an extinct [[Austronesian languages|Austronesian]] language of [[Papua New Guinea]]. It was restructured through contact with neighboring [[Papuan languages]], and in turn influencing them, before speakers shifted to those languages.

== External links ==
* [[Paradisec]] has the Tom Dutton collection ([http://catalog.paradisec.org.au/collections/TD1 TD1]) that includes Yoba language materials.

==See also==
*[[Magori language]], a similar situation
